lines: I'm the FISHING GURU's older brother! I simply Looove fishing!
reward: Take this and fish, young one!
Fishing is a way of life! From the seas to rivers, go out and land the big one, young one!

lines: Oh hey! Fancy meeting you here. You took down the boss, huh?
I'm really sorry I couldn't be there for it, but I was never really worried about you.
I've recently obtained the Mega Ring, so I'd like to put myself to the test!
battle: I see you've got one too! Let's not hold back then!
I feel the gap between us shrinking each time. I know I can do it! But, thanks for being a sport as always.
reward: With Sabrina's badge, you should be able to use this.

lines: Fwahahaha! A mere child like you dares to challenge me?
Very well, I shall show you true terror as a ninja master!
battle: You shall feel the despair of poison and sleep techniques!
Humph! You have proven your worth! Here! Take the Soul Badge!
When afflicted by Toxic, Pokémon suffer more and more as battle progresses! It will surely terrorize foes!
reward: Sealed within that TM06 lies Toxic! It is a secret technique dating back some four hundred years.
